title: Kings still No. 1, Pacers rise to No. 2
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 19

rankings.summaryHtml: Don't forget that they're STILL not at full strength. Only when Bobby Jax comes back will Kings really have a bench.
rankings.summaryText: Don't forget that they're STILL not at full strength. Only when Bobby Jax comes back will Kings really have a bench.

rankings.summaryHtml: It was 23 games ago that the committee said there would be no second-half fade from Pacers. Turns out they're getting stronger, starting with Artest's speedy recovery.
rankings.summaryText: It was 23 games ago that the committee said there would be no second-half fade from Pacers. Turns out they're getting stronger, starting with Artest's speedy recovery.

rankings.summaryHtml: Who knew Duncan was holding them back? Rasho averages 17.0 ppg, 12.4 rpg and 3.4 bpg during a 4-1 run without TD ... during which Spurs top 100 points three times.

rankings.summaryHtml: One bad loss to the Iverson-less Sixers was forgivable. But this?  Committee could have dropped Wolves lower after two more curious home losses, the second coming to ... Boston?

rankings.summaryHtml: So much for momentum. Mavs better get a top-four seed if they want to reach the second round, because they've lost all confidence in their formerly unquestioned ability to win on the road.
rankings.summaryText: So much for momentum. Mavs better get a top-four seed if they want to reach the second round, because they've lost all confidence in their formerly unquestioned ability to win on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Says Kobe, apparently going for Understatement O' The Season: "It's an odd year." Truth is, there hasn't been a moment's peace since the day after Malone and Payton held their joint press conference.

rankings.summaryHtml: With the Atlantic locked up, and with only a mathematical hope of catching Indiana, Nets would be wise to let J-Kidd keep sitting and recharging. They can beat Pistons in Round 2 without home-court advantage, but only if Kidd is at full capacity.
rankings.summaryText: With the Atlantic locked up, and with only a mathematical hope of catching Indiana, Nets would be wise to let J-Kidd keep sitting and recharging. They can beat Pistons in Round 2 without home-court advantage, but only if Kidd is at full capacity.

rankings.summaryHtml: Larry is never satisfied, but not even he can complain this week after Pistons became the first team in the shot-clock era to hold three straight opponents under 70. Can he?
rankings.summaryText: Larry is never satisfied, but not even he can complain this week after Pistons became the first team in the shot-clock era to hold three straight opponents under 70. Can he?

rankings.summaryHtml: With a 24-7 record since Jan. 1, and needing only four more wins to clinch their first winning season EVER, Grizz are making it very, very tough to keep them out of the top eight. We simply couldn't figure out which team to drop out.
rankings.summaryText: With a 24-7 record since Jan. 1, and needing only four more wins to clinch their first winning season EVER, Grizz are making it very, very tough to keep them out of the top eight. We simply couldn't figure out which team to drop out.

rankings.summaryHtml: They've been needing quality wins against Western opposition and just bagged two, beating Minny in Minny and halting their hex against Dallas by holding off Mavs at home. Does this mean we have a Terrific Ten, as opposed to an Elite Eight?
rankings.summaryText: They've been needing quality wins against Western opposition and just bagged two, beating Minny in Minny and halting their hex against Dallas by holding off Mavs at home. Does this mean we have a Terrific Ten, as opposed to an Elite Eight?

rankings.summaryHtml: Milwaukee has a real opportunity to claim the No. 4 seed, with Hornets stumbling and four of its next five games at home. But the Bucks are mired in their own 7-9 malaise.
rankings.summaryText: Milwaukee has a real opportunity to claim the No. 4 seed, with Hornets stumbling and four of its next five games at home. But the Bucks are mired in their own 7-9 malaise.

rankings.summaryHtml: This is unacceptable, Utah. A sub-.500 record? In the Midwest Division? This just won't do.
rankings.summaryText: This is unacceptable, Utah. A sub-.500 record? In the Midwest Division? This just won't do.

rankings.summaryHtml: The only thing to cheer up Nuggets these days is the way Portland is unraveling anew. Because it looks like Denver will need all the help it can get to hold onto the No. 8 spot.
rankings.summaryText: The only thing to cheer up Nuggets these days is the way Portland is unraveling anew. Because it looks like Denver will need all the help it can get to hold onto the No. 8 spot.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's not Mash, who has already nailed two game-winning shots since coming back from injury. Floyd better figure out whatever it is, or else he won't have a winning record here, either.
rankings.summaryText: It's not Mash, who has already nailed two game-winning shots since coming back from injury. Floyd better figure out whatever it is, or else he won't have a winning record here, either.

rankings.summaryHtml: Committee didn't have nice things to say about the McInnis acquisition, but facts is facts: Cavs' new PG has a sparkling 67 assists against eight turnovers in the past seven games.
rankings.summaryText: Committee didn't have nice things to say about the McInnis acquisition, but facts is facts: Cavs' new PG has a sparkling 67 assists against eight turnovers in the past seven games.

rankings.summaryHtml: All credit to Odom, who has never been better. Back-to-back wins over Bucks and Kings, meanwhile, could be the springboard for a run that gets Heat into the playoffs.
rankings.summaryText: All credit to Odom, who has never been better. Back-to-back wins over Bucks and Kings, meanwhile, could be the springboard for a run that gets Heat into the playoffs.

rankings.summaryHtml: If Knicks want the No. 6 seed, this is the time to make their move, with seven of 11 at home for the rest of the month and winnable roadies vs. Sixers and Bulls. Plus Houston is back from injury.

rankings.summaryHtml: Truth be told, Ainge would undoubtedly prefer a lottery pick. But he has to be enjoying a 5-0 spurt almost as much as Coach Carroll, even if the opposition -- Minnesota aside -- has been on the weak side.
rankings.summaryText: Truth be told, Ainge would undoubtedly prefer a lottery pick. But he has to be enjoying a 5-0 spurt almost as much as Coach Carroll, even if the opposition -- Minnesota aside -- has been on the weak side.

rankings.summaryHtml: Lose at home to Bonzi's Grizz, then lose at home to Sheed's Pistons, then lose by 20 on the road to Clips with Zach suspended. It's weeks like that which make Cheeks' return to Philly seem inevitable.
rankings.summaryText: Lose at home to Bonzi's Grizz, then lose at home to Sheed's Pistons, then lose by 20 on the road to Clips with Zach suspended. It's weeks like that which make Cheeks' return to Philly seem inevitable.

rankings.summaryHtml: Safe to say Sonics' playoff fantasies have been extinguished. It's hard to say why they've fared better without Ray Allen in the lineup than they've fared without Brent Barry.

rankings.summaryHtml: A 4-11 slide edges Clips ever closer to their 11th straight losing season. The record is 15 if you're curious: Sacramento from 1983-98.

rankings.summaryHtml: Phoenix has a chance to ruin someone else's season with three cracks at Mavs in the next 14 games. Beyond that, there's not a lot going on here.

rankings.summaryHtml: Raps have thrown themselves a lifeline with wins over Heat and Hornets. But they still look like the team most likely to drop out of the East's top eight.

rankings.summaryHtml: Committee still believes that Warriors, had they been healthy, would have challenged for No. 8. But now Van Exel, to continue the injury trend, is probably done for the season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Are we all in agreement now that Sixers will be the first of the six Sub-.500 Playoff Hopefuls to be eliminated from the race? It sounds like even AI agrees: "This might be the worst season that I've had since I've been a Sixer."
